M07_directed_cases.static_behavior: 有效道具/非调用招到点首1、下次2/F1.4保持；新增空或非TACKLE前提明确不接收此输入。
第一次到点归0、记录TACKLE、免疫后保留；下次同招1/F1.2。

M07_directed_cases.case: 初始最近身份为其它有效招
M07_directed_cases.static_behavior: 与TACKLE身份不等，第一次归0，后继1/F1.2。

M07_directed_cases.case: 首次成功与不同招反向对照
M07_directed_cases.static_behavior: MET02显式继承初态；首次成功同样建立TACKLE，下次同招1；不同非调用身份归0。
MET03及WP40L194不变；早退不触及旧计数且清最近身份，下次到点才归0。

M07_directed_cases.case: 无效物品/调用外壳/初始化与读取上限
M07_directed_cases.static_behavior: MET04/05及WP40L194不变，跳过与清零时点分开，内层可以更新，初始化0及读取min5保持。

M08_directed_cases.input: Existing SH01/SH03 legal positive HP loss, same fixed R, normal scene callbacks
M08_directed_cases.expected_static: ShadowHalfU5/T7→3/4 and ShadowEndU5→2 still submit HP; omit only common HealthDown. Each positive HP loss requests existing bar update/wait, then registers flags when display returns normally. Old HP-bar-suppressed statement absent from active normative bytes.

M08_directed_cases.input: Same positive reduction, exception during HP-bar callback/update before it returns; prior flags false and no earlier exception
M08_directed_cases.expected_static: HP already changed and writes persistent creature; no new flags are registered by the not-yet-reached suffix; remaining ShadowHalf members/item scan/recharge or ShadowEnd feedback/item check are not guaranteed. Existing flags are not automatically cleared. WP46L281 plus retained SH09 express this boundary.

M08_directed_cases.input: Normal HP-bar callback returned; subsequent move-specific half/recoil message fails
M08_directed_cases.expected_static: Already reached HP and two-flag/conditional-crossing prefix remains; later item/recharge writes not auto-completed, no rollback guaranteed. SH09 remains scoped to actually reached writes.

Default registerDamage true for Shadow remains; no complete direct-hit damage/source record guarantee. PainSplit reduction avoids new damage flags via its distinct existing contract; §6.4 byte-identical v1→v2. Amounts/guards/move-local order unchanged.

M07_necessary_regression_reuse.fresh_comparison: 合同精确旧control/owner为空；不猜配Shift/FuryCutter。WP50§3.2倍率min读取与覆盖身份、WP47-A调用记录层保持；本次FAIL限MET初始身份，不更改旧公式。

M08_necessary_regression_reuse.prior_scope: M08 B10/B12 GIR-FD82-B017 and B05 A030: PainSplit/AI optional-data owner contracts remain unchanged. Full prior qualification retained; no transfer as execution or global old-control signature.
M08_necessary_regression_reuse.direct_v2_byte_preservation: WP46 §6.4 unchanged, SH01–03/SH05–09 unchanged; M08 other normative receivers/appendices unchanged and required old WP47 rows preserved per independent checks.

source_owner_boundary: Original exact legacy owner/scope receipts remain at round-01 fixed commit; only unchanged facts reused. No old PASS widened or historical status altered.
